#!/bin/bash
# yooai-send-to.sh "<message>" "<chat-id-or-topic-substring>"
# Smart send: resolves topic → id via YooMD, installs bot if missing, posts via Bot Framework as Dr. Yoo's Anthropic Agent.
set -euo pipefail
MSG="${1:?Usage: $0 \"<message>\" \"<chat-id-or-topic>\"}"
LOCATOR="${2:?Usage: $0 \"<message>\" \"<chat-id-or-topic>\"}"
TENANT=50186224-2255-444a-b321-60a84114115c
APP_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name SDN-YooVault --name yooai-agent-app-id --query value -o tsv)
SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name SDN-YooVault --name yooai-agent-client-secret --query value -o tsv)
CATALOG_APP_ID=1b867741-ad6e-4c33-b705-864c9ae207e7
# Resolve chat id. Accept 19:* (group/channel), a:* (personal 1:1), or topic name.
if [[ "$LOCATOR" == 19:* || "$LOCATOR" == a:* ]]; then
    CHAT_ID="$LOCATOR"
    echo "using chat-id: $CHAT_ID" >&2
else
    YOO_TOKEN=$(/home/azureuser/yoomd-graph-token.sh)
    CHAT_ID=$(LOCATOR="$LOCATOR" YOO_TOKEN="$YOO_TOKEN" python3 <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request, os, sys
t = os.environ["YOO_TOKEN"]; q = os.environ["LOCATOR"].lower()
url = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/chats?$top=50&$select=id,topic,chatType"
while url:
    r = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+t})).read())
    for c in r.get("value",[]):
        if q in (c.get("topic") or "").lower():
            print(c["id"]); sys.exit(0)
    url = r.get("@odata.nextLink","")
sys.exit(1)
PY
) || { echo "no chat matching \"$LOCATOR\"" >&2; exit 1; }
    echo "resolved topic \"$LOCATOR\" -> chat $CHAT_ID" >&2
fi
# Personal 1:1 chats auto-install; installedApps endpoint returns 404 for a:* ids.
if [[ "$CHAT_ID" != a:* ]]; then
    GRAPH_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "https://login.microsoftonline.com/$TENANT/oauth2/v2.0/token" \
      --data-urlencode "client_id=$APP_ID" --data-urlencode "client_secret=$SECRET" \
      --data-urlencode "grant_type=client_credentials" \
      --data-urlencode "scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default" \
      | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')
    INSTALLED=$(curl -s "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/chats/$CHAT_ID/installedApps?\$expand=teamsApp" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAPH_TOKEN" | python3 -c "
